# Interest-bearing Deposit

## Create Validation Set
```{r}
# Panel
intb_deposit_panel_data = deposit_panel_data[, c(34, 8, 41:43, 10:12, 14, 19, 22, 3, 44:58)]
intb_panel_cleaned = na.omit(intb_deposit_panel_data)

# Create factors
intb_panel_cleaned$newdate = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$newdate)
intb_panel_cleaned$year = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$year)
intb_panel_cleaned$Region = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$Region)
intb_panel_cleaned$bkclass = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$bkclass)
intb_panel_cleaned$specgrp = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$specgrp)
intb_panel_cleaned$mutual = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$mutual)
intb_panel_cleaned$regagnt = as.factor(intb_panel_cleaned$regagnt)

# Set the random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(2)

# Split the data into training and testing sets
train_frac <- 0.5
intb_panel_cleaned <- intb_panel_cleaned %>%
  arrange(newdate, cert) %>% # Arrange the data by quarter (newdate) and Bank_ID
  group_by(newdate) %>% # Group the data by quarter (newdate)
  mutate(sample_id = row_number(),
         total_rows = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(train_test = ifelse(sample_id <= total_rows * train_frac, "train", "test")) %>%
  select(-sample_id, -total_rows)

# Create training and testing datasets
intb_panel_train <- intb_panel_cleaned %>% filter(train_test == "train")
intb_panel_test <- intb_panel_cleaned %>% filter(train_test == "test")

# Drop the last column (the indicator of train vs test)
intb_panel_train = intb_panel_train[, -ncol(intb_panel_train)] 
intb_panel_test = intb_panel_test[, -ncol(intb_panel_test)] 

# Dataframe for regression
intb_panel_train_reg = intb_panel_train[, -c(2, 4, 6, 13:16, 18:22)] # drop cert and newdate and various short-term interest rates
intb_panel_test_reg = intb_panel_test[, -c(2, 4, 6, 13:16, 18:22)] # drop cert and newdate and various short-term interest rates
intb_panel_test_reg = intb_panel_test_reg[intb_panel_test_reg$Region != "Other", ]
```

## Panel

### Multiple Linear Regression

```{r}
intb.full.lm.p = lm(Interest_Bearing_Deposits ~ .,data = intb_panel_train_reg)
summary(intb.full.lm.p)
```

Multicollinearity may be an issue

```{r}
round(vif(intb.full.lm.p)[, 1], 2)
```

Testing Data Prediction

```{r}
intb_lm_pred = predict(intb.full.lm.p, newdata = intb_panel_test_reg)
intb_lm_tmse = mean((intb_panel_test_reg$Interest_Bearing_Deposits-intb_lm_pred)^2)
```
